create_humanoid_env: create a Humanoid environment with a specified env_task like moon or normal
configure_gravity_task: configure the Humanoid environment to use moon gravity with 0.15 coefficient
modify_body_mass: modify body mass and collider radius for torso or shin using env_tasks config
apply_observation_mask: apply a random observation mask to reduce observable dimensions in the Humanoid env
review_humanoid_class: review the Humanoid class init method and its env_task configuration handling
